phase_name: Declare Each Gate's Input Corpus in the Registry

objectives.description: Add input_corpus field to row format, header docs, loader read line/array, normalize '-' placeholder, add accessor case
Define corpus grammar and record in data file header
Populate all 23 rows from each gate's actual reads; planning note under progress/
Extend lint-gate-registry.sh: field-count rejection, empty-corpus rejection, unparseable-entry rejection
Registry-resolution cases: nine-field round trip, '-' reads as empty, eight-field row rejected
Confirm no behavioural change: field loaded/queryable, nothing reads it yet

approaches_tried.approach: regex character class with backslash-escaped [ and ] inside a POSIX bracket expression for corpus-entry grammar validation
approaches_tried.reason: backslash is not an escape character inside a POSIX ERE bracket expression; every entry failed to match. Fixed using POSIX character classes ([[:alnum:]_.*][][:alnum:]_./*?-]*) with a leading ']' placed immediately after the opening bracket to include it literally.

approaches_tried.approach: git stash push/pop to capture a clean before/after diff for the byte-identical full-battery verification criterion
approaches_tried.reason: the PreToolUse guard-destructive-git.sh hook refused the whole chained command (including the push) because the chain's own later 'git stash pop' targeted what it classified as a foreign stash entry under concurrent multi-session use -- confirmed no stash was actually created (git stash list showed no new entry, working tree files remained modified/intact). Abandoned stash-based diffing as unsafe with concurrent sessions active; substituted structural grep evidence (no consumer reads the new field) plus a direct --only-gate run confirming only the known pre-existing gate16/gate20 findings, no new failures.

verification.lint_gate_registry: bash lint/lint-gate-registry.sh passes cleanly on the real, populated gate-registry.data (7/7 checks); rejects a deliberately eight-field row, a blank (non-'-') corpus field, and an unparseable entry -- all three confirmed live and encoded as cases 28-30
verification.no_behavioral_change: structural: grep confirms no file outside gate-registry.data/gate-registry-lib.sh/lint-gate-registry.sh/test-gate-registry-resolution.sh references input_corpus/_GREG_INPUT_CORPUS; verify-deploy.sh itself untouched. Direct run: 'verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 1,2,9,14,16,20 --findings --quiet .' against the current (post-edit) tree produces only the two known-pre-existing findings (gate16 lean routing_hard warning, gate20 eager-load-over-baseline), no new failures. A full byte-identical before/after capture via git stash was attempted and abandoned (see approaches_tried) as unsafe under concurrent multi-session use; this lighter but direct evidence is substituted.
verification.accessor_field_values_unchanged: test-gate-registry-resolution.sh cases 1-7 (against the REAL data file) confirm gate_registry_field still resolves invoke/serialized/requires_source_store/timeout_s identically to before this phase for every probed id
